question: выручка по месяцам
golden_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date)::date AS month, round(sum(total_amount)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE NOT is_deleted AND status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: выручка новых клиентов по месяцам
golden_sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, min(order_date) AS first_order_date FROM orders WHERE NOT is_deleted AND status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, round(sum(o.total_amount)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN first_orders f ON f.customer_id = o.customer_id AND f.first_order_date = o.order_date WHERE NOT o.is_deleted AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: топ категорий по выручке
golden_sql: SELECT p.category, round(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: выручка по регионам
golden_sql: SELECT s.region, round(sum(o.total_amount)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE NOT o.is_deleted AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: заказы по статусам
golden_sql: SELECT status, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE NOT is_deleted GROUP BY status ORDER BY orders DESC;

question: клиенты по регионам
golden_sql: SELECT c.region, count(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers FROM customers c WHERE NOT c.is_deleted GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY customers DESC;

question: доля доставок в срок
golden_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * avg((delivered_at <= shipped_at + interval '5 days')::int), 2) AS on_time_percent FROM shipments WHERE status = 'delivered';

question: выручка по оплатам
golden_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', paid_at)::date AS month, round(sum(amount)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM order_payments WHERE status IN ('captured', 'partial') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
